headline: Light.
Leaf.
Season.
heroNote: Close looking at plants — in the garden I work in, in glasshouses, and wherever else I end up with a camera.
aboutBody: I'm a horticulturist at RHS Wisley. The job is mostly close, patient looking — knowing when a flower is three days from its best, or when the light finally reaches something that spends most of the day in shade. The camera comes out of the same habit, at work and wherever else I travel.
Shot on a Sony a7CR with a 24–105mm. Names are my best guess where I'm not certain of the exact species — corrections are always welcome.
